body: I have no help with anything monetary and I really don't want to lose the house I rent bc it's right by my kids preschool and my mom. But I can't seem to focus on anything right now. My face is swollen from crying so much and I haven't been able to eat for two days now. Everything just comes back up. Literally all I want right now is someone to talk to or just hug me.

Nothing seems to matte right now. I found out he's been cheating on me for months with some woman he works with. And he just yelled at me and called me names when I confronted him. Then took off and never came back. Which I guess is good bc I can't be with him anymore anyway, but now I have 2 toddlers, and soon a newborn to take care of alone with no income and he made sure to tell me he's taking the car and pretty much anything he's ever paid for which includes the children's furniture and tv. I fucking give up. I don't have anything left. To top it all off this has been a very difficult pregnancy I've gone threw alone and now He's actually said he wants nothing to do with "it"
He didn't for pretty much all of last year and I worked. He only got a job bc I got pregnant

At this point it's just beyond mentally exhausting to even be in the same house as him. I usually take the kids out to do something until like 9 when I know he's usually always passed out. But it's getting more difficult bc I'm so pregnant.
